blurb.en: The whole game in under a hundred lines: W and S move the left paddle, the computer moves the right one, the ball bounces off the top and bottom walls and off both paddles, and a ball that gets past a paddle scores a point for the other side.
blurb.zh: 不到一百行的完整游戏：W、S 键移动左拍，电脑控制右拍；球撞上下墙、撞两边的拍子都会弹回，漏过拍子的球给对方记一分。

en: What the window shows: a dark window with a dashed grey net down the middle, a white paddle near each side and a small yellow ball. The score, left then right, is at the top in purple. Hold W or S to move the left paddle up or down; the right paddle is the computer's. The ball starts in the middle heading right and downwards. When it gets past a paddle and leaves the window, the other side's number goes up by one and the ball is served again from the middle, towards the side that has just won the point.
In trace mode the program comes in three segments, one at a time: the constants and ball_step, then the small helpers and draw, then main.

ball_step does one frame's thinking about the ball. It builds a pygame.Rect the size of the ball around its centre (a Rect holds whole numbers, so the position is rounded) and then decides the new velocity. Every bounce sets a direction instead of flipping one: touching the top makes vy its absolute value, so the ball is heading down, and touching the bottom makes it the negative of that; vx is treated the same way at the two paddles. Simply negating goes wrong when the ball is still overlapping a paddle on the next frame - it is turned round a second time, back into the paddle. The Bouncing off the Walls program on the Motion & Physics page makes the same choice for the same reason.

The collision tests themselves, colliderect between the ball's box and each paddle's Rect, are used here, not explained; the Sprites & Collisions page covers them. The game keeps its pieces as plain Rects and tuples in lists: these games do not use Sprite classes. How Sprite and Group are used is on the Sprites & Collisions page.

A ball whose right edge is left of the window (box.right < 0) has gone out completely on the left, so the right-hand player scores; the mirror case scores for the left. ball_step reports this as one of three strings - play, left-scores or right-scores - and main does the counting and the serving, so the rules for the ball stay in one function.

The computer's paddle moves towards the ball by at most AI_SPEED times the frame's time each frame; An AI Paddle with a Speed Limit is about exactly this. AI_SPEED is 150 and the ball always moves up or down at 180 pixels a second, so on a long, steep run the paddle falls behind: if you return every ball, it misses about four a minute. W and S are read with key.get_pressed, which says which keys are held down right now; the Pygame Basics page covers keyboard input.

The page's checker compares ball_step with a version that never builds a Rect: it works out the ball's four edges by arithmetic, tests the overlap edge by edge and sets the signs with math.copysign - on hundreds of made-up positions, velocities and paddle heights, four in ten of them with the ball already out of the window.
zh: 窗口里看到的：深色窗口正中一条灰色虚线当球网，左右两边各一块白色拍子，一个小小的黄色球。顶上是紫色的比分，左边的在前。按住 W 或 S 让左拍上下移动；右拍由电脑控制。球从正中出发，往右下方走。球漏过某一边的拍子、出了窗口，另一边的分数加一，球再从正中发出，朝刚得分的那一边走。
临摹模式里这个程序分三段、一段一段来：常量与 ball_step；几个小函数与 draw；main。

ball_step 负责球在这一帧里的全部判断。它先围着球心建一个与球一样大的 pygame.Rect（Rect 只存整数，所以位置要先舍入），再决定新的速度。每一次反弹都是「定方向」而不是「翻方向」：碰到顶边，vy 取它的绝对值，于是球朝下走；碰到底边，vy 取绝对值的相反数；两块拍子对 vx 也这样处理。单纯取反的问题出在球下一帧还和拍子重叠的时候——它会被再掉头一次，又钻回拍子里。「运动与物理」一页的「撞墙反弹」出于同样的理由做了同样的选择。
碰撞判定本身——球的方框与每块拍子的 Rect 做 colliderect——这里只用、不讲，见「精灵与碰撞」一页。游戏里的东西都是放在列表里的普通 Rect 与元组——这几个游戏没有用 Sprite 类；Sprite / Group 的用法见「精灵与碰撞」一页。
球的右边已经在窗口左边之外（box.right < 0），说明它完全从左边出去了，于是右边得分；镜像的情形给左边记分。ball_step 用三个字符串之一报告结果——play、left-scores、right-scores——记分和发球交给 main，球的规则就都待在一个函数里。
电脑的拍子每一帧朝球移动，最多移动 AI_SPEED 乘这一帧的时长；「有速度上限的 AI 拍子」讲的就是这件事。AI_SPEED 是 150，而球上下移动的速度始终是每秒 180 像素，所以遇到又长又陡的一段，拍子会跟不上：如果你每个球都接回去，它大约每分钟漏四个。W、S 用 key.get_pressed 读——它说的是此刻哪些键正按着；键盘输入见「pygame 入门」一页。
页面的检查器把 ball_step 与另一个从不建 Rect 的版本比较：它用算术求出球的四条边，一条边一条边地判重叠，再用 math.copysign 定正负号——在几百组随手造的位置、速度与拍子高度上逐一核对，其中四成的球已经在窗口之外。

lineNotes.en: Setting center moves the box so that its middle is at this point; a Rect stores whole numbers.
lineNotes.zh: 给 center 赋值，是把方框挪到让它的中心落在这一点上；Rect 只存整数。

lineNotes.at: right_y += max(-step, min(step, ball.y - PADDLE_H / 2 - right_y))
lineNotes.en: The gap between where the paddle is and where it wants to be (centred on the ball), clamped to at most step either way.
lineNotes.zh: 拍子现在的位置与想去的位置（正对球心）之差，再夹在正负 step 之内。

lineNotes.en: ball_step hands back a plain tuple (the checker compares built-in types); main turns it back into a Vector2.
lineNotes.zh: ball_step 交回的是普通元组（检查器比的是内置类型）；main 再把它变回 Vector2。

chunks.from: """Pong: two paddles and a ball; the ball bounces off walls and paddles, and a miss scores a point."""

title.en: An AI Paddle with a Speed Limit
title.zh: 有速度上限的 AI 拍子

blurb.en: A computer-controlled paddle follows the ball, but each frame it may move only speed times dt. With a limit it can be beaten; the Up and Down keys change the limit so you can see where it stops missing.
blurb.zh: 电脑控制的拍子追着球走，但每一帧最多只能移动 speed 乘 dt。有了上限，它才打得过；上下方向键改这个上限，看它从多快开始不再漏球。

en: What the window shows: a dark window with a white paddle near the right edge and a yellow ball bouncing around. The ball bounces off the left, top and bottom walls; on the right it bounces off the paddle - or, if the paddle is not there, leaves the window, adds one to the misses and starts again from the middle. The purple text at the top shows the paddle's speed limit and the number of misses. Up raises the limit by 60 pixels a second; Down lowers it by 60, never below 60.

ai_follow has three cases. If the ball is within one step of the paddle's centre, the paddle goes straight there, centred on the ball. Otherwise it moves one step towards the ball: down if the ball is below the centre, up if it is above. Last, the position is kept on the screen, between 0 and HEIGHT - PADDLE_H.

Why the limit matters: a paddle that jumps to the ball every frame can never miss, and nobody can beat it. The ball here moves up and down at 250 pixels a second. At the starting limit of 180 the paddle falls behind and misses every ball, about one a second; one press of Up, to 240, and it never misses - a little slower than the ball is enough, because the paddle is 80 pixels tall and only has to get part of itself in the way. The ball follows the same path every time, which is why it is all or nothing here; in the Pong program the rallies vary.

The step is speed times dt, so the paddle covers the same distance in a second at any frame rate. The first case also stops a paddle that is already level with the ball from shaking: without it, the paddle would step past the ball, then back again, every frame.

The bounce off the paddle uses Rect.collidepoint on the ball's right-most point; collisions are used here, not explained - the Sprites & Collisions page covers them. Up and Down are KEYDOWN events, one per press; the Pygame Basics page covers events.

The page's checker compares ai_follow with a version that works out how far the paddle wants to move and clamps that distance between -step and step with max and min - on hundreds of made-up paddle heights, ball heights, speeds and frame times, some with the ball within one step and some with the paddle pinned against an edge.
zh: 窗口里看到的：深色窗口，右边缘附近一块白色拍子，一个黄色球满屏弹。球撞左、上、下三面墙都会弹回；到了右边，撞上拍子就弹回——拍子不在那里，球就出了窗口，漏球数加一，球再从正中出发。顶上的紫色文字显示拍子的速度上限与漏球数。按上方向键上限加每秒 60 像素；按下方向键减 60，最低 60。
ai_follow 分三种情形。球离拍子中心不到一步，拍子直接到位，正对球心。否则朝球走一步：球在中心下方就往下，在上方就往上。最后把位置夹在屏幕里，介于 0 与 HEIGHT - PADDLE_H 之间。
为什么非要有上限：每一帧都直接跳到球那里的拍子永远不会漏，谁也打不过它。这里的球上下移动的速度是每秒 250 像素。起始上限 180 时，拍子跟不上，每个球都漏，大约一秒一个；按一次上方向键到 240，就再也不漏了——比球稍慢也够，因为拍子有 80 像素高，只要有一部分挡在路上就行。球每次走的都是同一条路线，所以这里要么全漏、要么全接；「Pong 乒乓」里每个回合都不一样。
一步的长度是 speed 乘 dt，所以不论帧率多少，拍子一秒走的距离都一样。第一种情形还防止了已经正对着球的拍子来回抖：没有它，拍子会每帧先越过球一步、再退回来一步。
拍子挡球用的是 Rect.collidepoint，判的是球最右边那一点；碰撞只用、不讲，见「精灵与碰撞」一页。上下方向键是 KEYDOWN 事件，按一次来一次；事件见「pygame 入门」一页。
页面的检查器把 ai_follow 与另一个版本比较：它先算出拍子想走多远，再用 max 与 min 把这段距离夹在 -step 与 step 之间——在几百组随手造的拍子高度、球的高度、速度与帧时长上逐一核对，其中有的球在一步之内，有的拍子贴在边上。

lineNotes.en: max(low, min(high, value)) is the usual clamp: min stops the paddle going below the bottom, max stops it going above the top.
lineNotes.zh: max(下限, min(上限, 值)) 是常见的夹法：min 不让拍子低过底边，max 不让它高过顶边。

lineNotes.en: The ball's right-most point, rounded to whole pixels.
lineNotes.zh: 球最右边的那一点，舍入到整像素。

blurb.en: The whole game: the snake moves one cell at a time on a 20 by 20 grid, the arrow keys turn it, eating food makes it one cell longer, and running into a wall or into itself ends the game. Food appears on a random free cell.
blurb.zh: 完整的游戏：蛇在 20 × 20 的格子上一格一格地走，方向键转向，吃到食物长一格，撞墙或撞到自己游戏结束。食物随机落在空格上。

en: What the window shows: a dark square window, divided (invisibly) into 20 by 20 cells of 24 pixels. The snake is three green cells on the left of the middle row, its head a paler green, heading right; the red square is the food. The arrow keys turn it, and it moves one cell every 0.12 seconds. Each piece of food makes it one cell longer - the white text at the top left shows its length - and a new piece appears on a free cell. Running into the edge or into its own body stops it, and Game over - press R to play again appears in the middle.
In trace mode the program comes in three segments, one at a time: the constants, the key table and snake_step; placing food, starting a new game and draw; and main.

snake_step works out one move without changing the list it is given. The new head is the old head plus the direction. It is a crash if the head is off the grid, or if it lands on the body - but not on the last cell, because on this move the tail moves out of the way, so the test uses a slice of the body without its last cell. Food makes the new body the head followed by the whole old body, one cell longer; otherwise it is the head followed by the old body minus its last cell, the same length.

place_food lists every cell the snake is not on and picks one with rng.choice. rng is random.Random(SEED), made once in main and passed in, so the food comes in the same order on every run: with this seed the first piece appears in the bottom row. A different seed gives a different order.

A key that would turn the snake straight back is ignored, because the new head would land on its neck. The test is against direction - the way the snake last moved - not against turn, so two quick key presses between moves cannot sneak a reversal through. Moves happen on a timer: timer adds up the frame times, and each time it passes STEP_TIME the snake moves once, so it runs at the same speed at any frame rate.

The Snake Step with a List and Snake Step with a Deque programs take the single move apart. The arrow keys arrive as KEYDOWN events; the Pygame Basics page covers events. The game keeps its pieces as plain Rects and tuples in lists: these games do not use Sprite classes. How Sprite and Group are used is on the Sprites & Collisions page.

The page's checker compares snake_step with a version that tests the grid with range, looks for a crash by walking the body with an index, and builds the new body one cell at a time with append - on hundreds of made-up snakes, three in ten of them curled so that the head is about to move into the cell the tail is leaving.
zh: 窗口里看到的：一个深色的正方形窗口，（看不见地）分成 20 × 20 个 24 像素的格子。蛇是中间一行偏左的三个绿色格子，蛇头颜色浅一些，朝右走；红色方块是食物。方向键让它转向，它每 0.12 秒走一格。每吃到一个食物就长一格——左上角的白字显示它的长度——并在一个空格上出现新的食物。撞到边缘或自己的身体就停下，正中出现 Game over - press R to play again。
临摹模式里这个程序分三段、一段一段来：常量、按键表与 snake_step；放食物、开新局与 draw；main。
snake_step 算出一步，但不改动交给它的列表。新的头等于旧的头加上方向。头出了格子算撞；头落在身体上也算撞——但最后一格除外，因为这一步尾巴会让开，所以判断用的是去掉最后一格的切片。吃到食物，新的蛇身是新头后面接上整条旧身体，长一格；没吃到，是新头后面接上去掉最后一格的旧身体，长度不变。
place_food 列出蛇不在的所有格子，用 rng.choice 挑一个。rng 是 random.Random(SEED)，在 main 里建一次、当实参传进来，所以每次运行食物出现的顺序都一样：这个种子下第一个食物出现在最底下一行。换一个种子，顺序就变了。
会让蛇直接掉头的按键被忽略，因为新头会落在它的脖子上。比较的对象是 direction——蛇上一步真正走的方向——而不是 turn，所以两步之间快速连按两个键也钻不出一次掉头。移动靠计时：timer 累加每帧的时长，每超过一次 STEP_TIME 蛇就走一格，所以不论帧率多少，它的速度都一样。
「贪吃蛇一步：列表」与「贪吃蛇一步：双端队列」把这一步单独拆出来练。方向键作为 KEYDOWN 事件到来；事件见「pygame 入门」一页。游戏里的东西都是放在列表里的普通 Rect 与元组——这几个游戏没有用 Sprite 类；Sprite / Group 的用法见「精灵与碰撞」一页。
页面的检查器把 snake_step 与另一个版本比较：它用 range 判是否出界，用下标逐格走一遍身体找碰撞，再用 append 一格一格建出新的蛇身——在几百条随手造的蛇上逐一核对，其中三成盘成一圈，蛇头正要走进尾巴此刻所在的那一格。

lineNotes.at: free = [(x, y) for x in range(N) for y in range(N) if (x, y) not in body]
lineNotes.en: Every cell of the grid that the snake is not on.
lineNotes.zh: 格子里蛇没占着的每一格。

lineNotes.en: timer goes back to 0.0 as well - otherwise the time spent on the game-over screen would come out as a burst of quick moves.
lineNotes.zh: timer 也放回 0.0——不然停在结束画面上的那段时间，会在开局时变成一串飞快的移动。

lineNotes.en: A comparison is itself True or False, so it can be stored straight into dead.
lineNotes.zh: 比较本身就是 True 或 False，可以直接存进 dead。

title.en: Constants, the key table and snake_step

chunks.from: """Snake: arrow keys steer, food makes the snake longer, and a wall or its own body ends the game."""

title.en: Placing food, a new game and drawing

blurb.en: Just the move, with the snake's body in a list: take the tail off, check for a crash, put the new head in at the front, and give the tail back only if the snake has eaten.
blurb.zh: 只练一步，蛇身放在列表里：先取下尾巴，判断撞没撞，把新头插到最前面，只有吃到了才把尾巴还回去。

en: What the window shows: a dark square window with a three-cell green snake heading right and a red food square. The arrow keys steer it, and it moves one cell every 0.15 seconds. The food appears at five fixed cells in turn, so every run is the same. If the snake hits an edge or itself it starts again from the left. Nothing stops it turning straight back, so pressing the opposite key crashes it into its own neck; the Snake program shows the guard against that.

advance changes the list in place. It takes the tail off first, so the crash test - is the head in the snake? - no longer sees it: on this move the tail moves out of the way, and moving into the cell the tail is leaving is allowed. After a crash the tail goes back on and nothing has changed. Otherwise the head goes in at position 0; if it is on the food, the tail goes back on too and the snake is one cell longer.

Inserting at position 0 of a list shifts every other element one place along, so it takes longer the longer the snake is. For a snake on a small grid that makes no visible difference; the Snake Step with a Deque program does the same move with a deque, where adding at the front shifts nothing.

snake_step is the three-line wrapper the checker calls: it copies body into a new list, lets advance change the copy, and hands back the copy with the state. main calls advance directly on its own snake.

The page's checker compares snake_step with a version that looks for a crash by walking the body with an index and builds the new body one cell at a time with append - on hundreds of made-up snakes, three in ten of them curled so that the head is about to move into the cell the tail is leaving.
zh: 窗口里看到的：深色的正方形窗口里一条三格长的绿蛇朝右走，还有一个红色的食物方块。方向键控制它，它每 0.15 秒走一格。食物轮流出现在五个固定的格子上，所以每次运行都一样。蛇撞到边缘或自己，就从左边重新开始。这里没有拦住直接掉头，按反方向键它会撞上自己的脖子；拦住掉头的写法见「贪吃蛇」。
advance 就地改动列表。它先取下尾巴，这样「头在不在蛇身里」的判断就看不到尾巴了：这一步尾巴本来就会让开，走进尾巴正要离开的那一格是允许的。撞了，就把尾巴放回去，什么都没变。没撞，就把新头插到下标 0；新头落在食物上，尾巴也放回去，蛇长了一格。
在列表的下标 0 插入，其余每个元素都要往后挪一位，所以蛇越长越慢。小格子上的蛇看不出差别；「贪吃蛇一步：双端队列」用 deque 做同一步，在最前面加元素不用挪任何东西。
snake_step 是检查器调用的三行包装：把 body 复制成一个新列表，让 advance 改这份副本，再把副本连同状态一起交回。main 则直接对自己的 snake 调用 advance。
页面的检查器把 snake_step 与另一个版本比较：它用下标逐格走一遍身体找碰撞，再用 append 一格一格建出新的蛇身——在几百条随手造的蛇上逐一核对，其中三成盘成一圈，蛇头正要走进尾巴此刻所在的那一格。

lineNotes.en: pop() with no argument removes the last element and hands it back.
lineNotes.zh: 不带实参的 pop() 取下最后一个元素并把它交回来。

lineNotes.en: % wraps round, so after the fifth piece of food the first cell comes back.
lineNotes.zh: % 让下标绕回来：第五个食物之后，又轮到第一个格子。

blurb.en: The same move with the body in a collections.deque: appendleft puts the new head at the front and pop takes the tail off, and both are quick however long the snake gets.
blurb.zh: 同一步，蛇身换成 collections.deque：appendleft 把新头放到最前面，pop 取下尾巴，两者都快，不论蛇有多长。

en: What the window shows: exactly what the Snake Step with a List program shows - a three-cell green snake heading right, a red food square at five fixed cells in turn, the arrow keys to steer, and a fresh start from the left after a crash.

Only the container changes. snake is a deque, and the new head goes in with appendleft rather than by inserting at position 0. A deque is built for adding and removing at both ends: appendleft and pop take the same short time however long the snake is, while a list has to shift every element to make room at the front. The Stacks & Queues page covers deques; this program just uses one.
The steps inside advance are the same as with a list: take the tail off, test for a crash (in works on a deque just as on a list), put the new head at the front, and give the tail back after eating.

snake_step builds a new deque from body, lets advance change it, and turns it back into a list for its answer. That last step matters to the checker, which compares types as well as values: a deque is not a list.

The page's checker compares snake_step with a version that looks for a crash by walking the body with an index and builds the new body one cell at a time with append - on hundreds of made-up snakes, three in ten of them curled so that the head is about to move into the cell the tail is leaving.
zh: 窗口里看到的：与「贪吃蛇一步：列表」完全一样——三格长的绿蛇朝右走，红色食物轮流出现在五个固定的格子上，方向键转向，撞了就从左边重新开始。
只换了容器。snake 是一个 deque，新头用 appendleft 放进去，而不是插到下标 0。deque 专为两头进出而造：不论蛇多长，appendleft 与 pop 都一样快；列表要在最前面腾出位置，就得把每个元素都往后挪。deque 见「栈与队列」一页，这里只是用它。
advance 里的步骤与列表版相同：先取下尾巴，判断撞没撞（in 对 deque 与对列表一样好用），把新头放到最前面，吃到了再把尾巴还回去。
snake_step 用 body 新建一个 deque，让 advance 改它，交回答案时再转回列表。这最后一步是为了检查器：它不但比值，也比类型，deque 不是 list。
页面的检查器把 snake_step 与另一个版本比较：它用下标逐格走一遍身体找碰撞，再用 append 一格一格建出新的蛇身——在几百条随手造的蛇上逐一核对，其中三成盘成一圈，蛇头正要走进尾巴此刻所在的那一格。

lineNotes.en: pop() with no argument removes the last element and hands it back.
lineNotes.zh: 不带实参的 pop() 取下最后一个元素并把它交回来。

lineNotes.en: % wraps round, so after the fifth piece of food the first cell comes back.
lineNotes.zh: % 让下标绕回来：第五个食物之后，又轮到第一个格子。

blurb.en: The whole game: three rows of ten bricks, a paddle on the arrow keys and one ball. Rect.collidelist finds the first brick the ball touches; that brick is deleted and the ball bounces back.
blurb.zh: 完整的游戏：三行、每行十块砖，方向键控制的拍子，一个球。Rect.collidelist 找出球碰到的第一块砖，删掉它，球弹回去。

en: What the window shows: a dark window with three rows of ten bricks near the top - red, orange and green - a white paddle near the bottom and a small purple ball just above it, already moving up and to the right. Left and Right move the paddle. The ball bounces off the side walls, the top and the paddle, and each brick it touches disappears. Miss the ball and Missed - press Space to play again appears; clear all thirty bricks and You win - press Space to play again. Space then starts a new game.
In trace mode the program comes in three segments, one at a time: the constants and the wall of bricks; brick hits, wall bounces and drawing; and main.

brick_hit turns the ball into a Rect and asks collidelist which brick it touches. collidelist gives back the index of the first rectangle in the list that overlaps, or -1 when none does. brick_hit turns -1 into None, so the caller asks is not None and cannot mistake -1 for a real position - as a list index, -1 would quietly mean the last brick. Collisions are used here, not explained; the Sprites & Collisions page covers them.

bounce_off_walls sets a direction with abs rather than flipping one, for the same reason as the Pong paddles. The paddle steers the ball too: the ball leaves with a sideways speed of five times the distance between its centre and the paddle's centre, so a hit near one end sends it off at a sharp angle. A brick simply turns the ball round vertically.

make_bricks builds all thirty Rects with one list comprehension over rows and columns; each brick starts 62 pixels (a brick and a gap) to the right of the one before, leaving a 12-pixel margin on each side of the wall. A brick's colour is worked out from its y when it is drawn. The game keeps its pieces as plain Rects and tuples in lists: these games do not use Sprite classes. How Sprite and Group are used is on the Sprites & Collisions page.

The page's checker compares brick_hit with a version that loops over the bricks by hand and compares the four edges (only a real overlap counts; just touching does not) - on hundreds of made-up ball positions against random selections from the real wall, three in ten of them shuffled so that first in the list and first from the left are not the same brick.
zh: 窗口里看到的：深色窗口顶部三行砖，每行十块——红、橙、绿——底部一块白色拍子，拍子上方一个紫色小球，已经在往右上方走。左右方向键移动拍子。球撞侧墙、顶边和拍子都会弹回，碰到的砖就消失。没接住球，出现 Missed - press Space to play again；三十块砖全打掉，出现 You win - press Space to play again。这时按空格开新局。
临摹模式里这个程序分三段、一段一段来：常量与砖墙；砖块命中、撞墙反弹与绘制；main。
brick_hit 把球变成一个 Rect，问 collidelist 碰到了哪块砖。collidelist 交回列表里第一个相交的矩形的下标，一个都不相交时交回 -1。brick_hit 把 -1 换成 None，调用的一方写 is not None，就不会把 -1 当成真实的位置——当列表下标用，-1 会悄悄地指向最后一块砖。碰撞只用、不讲，见「精灵与碰撞」一页。
bounce_off_walls 用 abs「定方向」而不是「翻方向」，理由与「Pong 乒乓」的拍子相同。拍子还能控制球的方向：球离开时的横向速度，是球心与拍子中心之间距离的五倍，所以打在拍子一端，球会斜着飞出去。撞到砖，球只是竖直方向掉头。
make_bricks 用一个遍历行与列的列表推导式建出全部三十个 Rect；每块砖比前一块往右 62 像素（一块砖加一道缝），整面墙两边各留 12 像素。砖的颜色在画的时候由它的 y 算出来。游戏里的东西都是放在列表里的普通 Rect 与元组——这几个游戏没有用 Sprite 类；Sprite / Group 的用法见「精灵与碰撞」一页。
页面的检查器把 brick_hit 与另一个版本比较：它亲手逐块循环、比四条边（真重叠才算，只是贴着不算）——在几百组随手造的球的位置、从真实砖墙里随机挑出的砖上逐一核对，其中三成把砖的顺序打乱，让「列表里的第一块」与「从左数的第一块」不是同一块。

lineNotes.en: True - False is 1 and False - True is -1, so the difference of the two keys is a direction: 1, -1 or 0.
lineNotes.zh: True - False 是 1，False - True 是 -1，所以两个键相减就是方向：1、-1 或 0。

lineNotes.en: clamp_ip moves the paddle back inside the window if it has gone past an edge.
lineNotes.zh: clamp_ip：拍子越过了边缘，就把它挪回窗口里。

lineNotes.en: Left of the paddle's centre gives a negative number, so the ball goes left.
lineNotes.zh: 打在拍子中心左边得到负数，球就往左飞。

title.zh: 砖块命中、撞墙反弹与绘制

blurb.en: The whole game: a fleet of 24 aliens marches sideways, and when a step would take it into a wall it moves down a row and turns round instead. Left and Right move the cannon; Space fires one bullet at a time.
blurb.zh: 完整的游戏：24 个外星人组成的队伍横着行进，下一步会撞墙时就改为整体下移一行、掉头。左右方向键移动炮台，空格一次只能打一发子弹。

en: What the window shows: a very dark window with three rows of eight green aliens at the top and a purple cannon at the bottom. Every 0.35 seconds the whole fleet steps 10 pixels sideways; when a step would take it into a side wall it moves down a row instead and turns round. Left and Right move the cannon, and Space fires a yellow bullet straight up - but only when no bullet is already on the screen. A bullet that hits an alien removes it. Shoot them all and You win! appears; if the fleet reaches the cannon's row, the game is over. If you never shoot, the fleet takes about three minutes to land.
In trace mode the program comes in three segments, one at a time: the constants and the fleet; marching, rectangles and drawing; and main.

fleet_step moves the fleet as one. Moving right, only the right-most alien can reach the wall, so it looks at the largest x; moving left, the smallest. x is an alien's left edge, so the right-most alien's right edge is that x plus the alien's width: forget the width and the fleet slides part-way into the right wall before it turns. When a step is blocked the whole fleet moves down by drop instead of sideways and the direction changes sign; otherwise every alien moves direction times step. Starting from the left, the first turn comes after 21 steps, about seven seconds, with the right-most alien exactly touching the right edge.

The aliens are (x, y) tuples, and fleet_step builds a new list each time instead of changing the old one - the tuples could not be changed anyway. Rectangles are built only when needed, by alien_rects, for drawing and for the bullet's collidelist; the index collidelist gives back is the alien's position in aliens, because alien_rects keeps the same order. Collisions are used here, not explained; the Sprites & Collisions page covers them. The game keeps its pieces as plain Rects and tuples in lists: these games do not use Sprite classes. How Sprite and Group are used is on the Sprites & Collisions page.
One bullet at a time is the simplest rule: bullet is either None or a Rect, and Space makes a new one only while it is None. The Fire Cooldown program shows the other common rule, a timer.

The page's checker compares fleet_step with a version that first moves the whole fleet and then asks whether any alien has left the window - on hundreds of made-up fleets, three in ten of them pushed right up against the right wall and two in ten against the left.
zh: 窗口里看到的：很暗的窗口，顶部三行、每行八个绿色外星人，底部一门紫色炮台。每 0.35 秒整队横移 10 像素；下一步会撞上侧墙时，改为下移一行并掉头。左右方向键移动炮台，空格竖直向上发射一发黄色子弹——但只有屏幕上没有子弹时才行。子弹打中外星人，外星人就消失。全部打光，出现 You win!；队伍压到炮台那一行，游戏结束。一枪不开的话，队伍大约三分钟后落地。
临摹模式里这个程序分三段、一段一段来：常量与队伍；行进、矩形与绘制；main。

fleet_step 把整队当一个整体来移动。往右走，只有最右边的外星人可能碰墙，所以看最大的 x；往左走，看最小的。x 是外星人的左边，最右边那个外星人的右边是这个 x 再加上外星人的宽度：忘了宽度，队伍要先钻进右墙一截才掉头。某一步被挡住时，整队改为往下挪 drop、方向变号；否则每个外星人移动 direction 乘 step。从左边出发，走 21 步（约七秒）后第一次掉头，那时最右边的外星人恰好贴着右边缘。

外星人是 (x, y) 元组，fleet_step 每次都建一个新列表，而不是改旧的——元组本来也改不了。矩形只在需要时由 alien_rects 建出来，用来画、也用来给子弹做 collidelist；collidelist 交回的下标就是这个外星人在 aliens 里的位置，因为 alien_rects 保持同样的顺序。碰撞只用、不讲，见「精灵与碰撞」一页。游戏里的东西都是放在列表里的普通 Rect 与元组——这几个游戏没有用 Sprite 类；Sprite / Group 的用法见「精灵与碰撞」一页。
一次只许一发子弹是最简单的规则：bullet 要么是 None，要么是一个 Rect，只有它是 None 时按空格才会新建一发。另一种常见的规则——计时器——见「开火冷却」。
页面的检查器把 fleet_step 与另一个版本比较：它先让整队走一步，再看有没有哪个外星人出了窗口——在几百支随手造的队伍上逐一核对，其中三成紧贴着右墙、两成紧贴着左墙。

blurb.en: Holding Space asks for a shot every frame; a cooldown timer lets one through and then counts down before the next. try_fire returns the new time left and whether a shot was fired.
blurb.zh: 按住空格，每一帧都在要求开火；冷却计时器放一发出去，然后倒数完才放下一发。try_fire 交回新的剩余时间，以及这一帧有没有开火。

en: What the window shows: a very dark window with a purple cannon at the bottom. Hold Space and yellow bullets stream upwards, evenly spaced. The white text at the top shows the cooldown in seconds and how many bullets are on the screen; the thin red bar at the bottom left shrinks as the cooldown runs out. Up adds 0.05 seconds to the cooldown and Down takes 0.05 off, never going below 0.05.

try_fire runs once a frame. It first takes this frame's time off remaining. If some time is still left, there is no shot this frame, whatever the key is doing. If the time has run out and Space is held, it fires and starts the timer again at the full cooldown. If the time has run out and Space is not held, it waits at 0.0, ready to fire on the very next frame that Space is down.

At 60 frames a second the starting cooldown of 0.25 seconds lets a shot through every 15 frames - four shots a second - and a bullet takes about 0.9 seconds to leave the top of the window, so three or four are on the screen at once. At the smallest cooldown, 0.05, it is one shot every 3 frames, twenty a second.

remaining counts down in seconds using dt, so the rate of fire is the same at any frame rate, to within one frame. Space is read with key.get_pressed - is it held right now? - rather than as a KEYDOWN event, which would give only one shot per press; the Pygame Basics page covers both kinds of input.

The page's checker compares try_fire with a version that compares remaining and dt exactly, as fractions, before subtracting - on hundreds of made-up times left, with Space held or not. Some of them have remaining exactly equal to dt: the timer runs out on that very frame, and a held Space must fire.
zh: 窗口里看到的：很暗的窗口，底部一门紫色炮台。按住空格，黄色子弹一发接一发往上飞，间隔均匀。顶上的白字显示冷却时长（秒）与屏幕上的子弹数；左下角细细的红条随着冷却走完而缩短。上方向键给冷却加 0.05 秒，下方向键减 0.05 秒，最低 0.05。
try_fire 每帧运行一次。它先从 remaining 里减去这一帧的时长。还有剩余，这一帧就不开火，不管空格按没按。时间走完了、空格又按着，就开火，并把计时器重新设成整整一个冷却时长。时间走完了、空格没按，就停在 0.0 等着，空格一按下的那一帧就能开火。
每秒 60 帧时，起始冷却 0.25 秒每 15 帧放一发——每秒四发；一发子弹大约 0.9 秒飞出窗口顶边，所以屏幕上同时有三四发。冷却调到最小的 0.05，就是每 3 帧一发，每秒二十发。
remaining 用 dt 按秒倒数，所以不论帧率多少，射速都一样（误差不超过一帧）。空格用 key.get_pressed 读——此刻是不是按着——而不是当 KEYDOWN 事件读，那样按一次只能打一发；两种输入见「pygame 入门」一页。
页面的检查器把 try_fire 与另一个版本比较：它在做减法之前，先把 remaining 与 dt 当作分数精确地比一比——在几百组随手造的剩余时间、空格按着或没按的组合上逐一核对。其中有的 remaining 恰好等于 dt：计时器正好在这一帧走完，按着空格就必须开火。

lineNotes.en: True while Space is held down, frame after frame.
lineNotes.zh: 只要空格按着，每一帧都是 True。

lineNotes.at: bullets = [b for b in bullets if b.bottom > 0]
lineNotes.en: Keep only the bullets still at least partly on the screen.
lineNotes.zh: 只留下至少还有一部分在屏幕上的子弹。

blurb.en: A rock that touches the player costs a life; then the player flashes and cannot be hit for two seconds, and at zero lives the game is over. take_hit returns the new lives, the invulnerable time left and whether the game is over.
blurb.zh: 石头碰到玩家就掉一条命；之后玩家闪烁两秒、这段时间打不中，命数到 0 游戏结束。take_hit 交回新的命数、剩下的无敌时间，以及游戏是否结束。

en: What the window shows: a dark window with five red squares - rocks - falling from the top, each one starting again at the top after it leaves the bottom. The purple square near the bottom is the player, moved with the Left and Right arrow keys. White text at the top left reads lives 3. When a rock touches the player, the number drops by one and the player flashes, off and on five times a second, for two seconds; rocks pass straight through it while it flashes. When the last life goes, the player disappears, the rocks stop and the text reads GAME OVER.

take_hit runs once a frame, and the order inside it is the whole point. First the invulnerable time counts down by this frame's time, and is held at zero rather than going below it. Only then does it ask whether this frame's hit counts, and a hit counts only when the timer is exactly zero. So a hit on the frame the timer runs out does count: after counting down first, that frame is already an ordinary one. Asking first and counting down afterwards would ignore that hit and hand the player an extra frame of safety every time.

A hit that counts takes one life and starts the timer again at INVULN, two seconds. If that was the last life, the timer goes back to 0.0 instead - with no lives left there is nothing to protect - and the third value handed back, the game-over flag, is True exactly when lives has reached 0.

Why the two seconds are needed: at 60 frames a second a rock falls 4 pixels a frame, so on its way past it overlaps the 30-pixel-tall player for about 13 frames, a little over a fifth of a second. Without invulnerability each of those frames would be a hit, and a single rock would take all three lives in three frames.

The flashing is worked out from the same timer. int(invuln * 10) counts the tenths of a second left, and % 2 makes that alternate between even and odd, so the player is drawn only on the even tenths; once the timer is 0 it is drawn every frame. collidelist hands back the index of the first rock the player overlaps, or -1 when there is none - Rect collisions are on the Sprites & Collisions page.

The page's checker compares take_hit with a version that works out the time left without holding it at zero, decides from that whether the player can be hit, and sets the new lives and timer in one step - on hundreds of made-up frames. About four in ten of them are the frame on which the timer runs out, most of those with a hit on that very frame.
zh: 窗口里看到的：深色窗口里，五块红色方块——石头——从顶上往下落，每一块从底边出去后又从顶上重新落下。靠近底部的紫色方块是玩家，用左、右方向键移动。左上角的白字写着 lives 3。石头碰到玩家，数字就少一，玩家闪烁两秒，每秒灭、亮五次；闪烁期间石头直接穿过它。最后一条命没了，玩家消失，石头停住，文字变成 GAME OVER。
take_hit 每帧运行一次，里面的先后顺序正是要点。先把无敌时间减掉这一帧的时长，并托在零上，不让它变成负数。然后才问这一帧的撞击算不算：只有计时恰好是零时才算。所以在计时走完的那一帧被撞，照样算数：先倒计时，这一帧就已经是普通的一帧了。要是先判断、后倒计时，这一下撞击会被忽略，玩家每次都白白多躲过一帧。
算数的撞击掉一条命，并把计时重新设成 INVULN，也就是两秒。如果掉的是最后一条命，计时改回 0.0——一条命都没有了，也就没什么可保护的——交回的第三个值（游戏是否结束）恰好在 lives 到 0 时为 True。
为什么需要这两秒：每秒 60 帧时石头每帧落 4 像素，它经过 30 像素高的玩家时，前后大约有 13 帧与玩家重叠，略多于五分之一秒。没有无敌时间，这些帧每一帧都算一次撞击，一块石头三帧之内就能把三条命全拿走。
闪烁也由同一个计时决定。int(invuln * 10) 数的是还剩几个十分之一秒，% 2 让它在偶数与奇数之间交替，于是玩家只在偶数的那些十分之一秒里画出来；计时为 0 时则每帧都画。collidelist 交回玩家碰到的第一块石头的下标，一块都没碰到时交回 -1——矩形碰撞见「精灵与碰撞」一页。
页面的检查器把 take_hit 与另一个版本比较：它先算出剩下的时间、不托在零上，据此判断玩家此刻能不能被打中，再一步定出新的命数与计时——在几百组随手造的帧上逐一核对。其中约四成是计时正好走完的那一帧，多半还在同一帧被撞上。

lineNotes.en: True on every frame some rock overlaps the player, whether or not that hit will count.
lineNotes.zh: 只要有石头与玩家重叠，这一帧就是 True——算不算数由 take_hit 决定。

lineNotes.en: Drawn on even tenths of a second only, so the player blinks while invulnerable.
lineNotes.zh: 只在偶数的十分之一秒里画出来，所以无敌期间玩家一闪一闪。
